Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the confluence coordinates, confusing the Mississippi–Ohio confluence with the Mississippi–Missouri confluence near St. Louis (Confluence Point State Park at ~38.866, -90.118). The correct Mississippi–Ohio meeting point is at Cairo, Illinois, so this erroneous coordinate would have led to the wrong location.
